Card Q&A.a: No, this card can only delete 1 Digimon. If there are multiple opponent's Digimon with the highest DP, this card's player chooses 1 target among them to delete.
Card Q&A.q: If there are multiple opponent's Digimon with the highest DP, can I delete them all with this card's [Main] effect?

Effect: While you have a Digimon with [Legend-Arms] in its traits in play, you may use this card without meeting its color requirements.
[Main] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the highest DP.
